English: Object-Oriented Programming is a programming paradigm that organizes software using
objects containing data and behavior.
සිංහල: Data සහ ඒ data සමඟ වැඩ කරන methods, objects විදිහට සංවිධානය කරලා software එකකේ develop කරන ක්‍රමයකේ.

Four pillars of OOP
Encapsulation — Protect data
Abstraction — Hide complexity
Inheritance — Reuse behavior
Polymorphism — Many forms
Code snippets are independent examples. Statements marked Inside main belong inside a Java main method.
English: A class is a blueprint used to create objects. An object is an instance of a class.
සිංහල: Class එකකේ කියන්Jන් සැලැස්මකේ. Object එකකේ කියන්Jන් ඒ සැලැස්ම අනුව නිර්මාණය කරපු instance එකකේ.
Real-world example: A car design is a class; individual red and blue cars are objects.
Car class → car1: Red / car2: Blue
Result / explanation: Car is driving. Each object has its own color.
